Publication types: Articles, Books, Chapters, Short Articles,

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "search" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "search" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
